हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: A humble street vendor’s life shatters when his wife abandons him for wealth, only for destiny to flip the script overnight. Sameer discovers he’s the sole heir to a billion-dollar empire, but power comes with betrayal, revenge, and dangerous truths. From humiliation to the boardroom, will he rise as a ruthless CEO or lose himself in the game?
